candidate_sources.docs/host-api.md: Controller verbs: run(value), close(), disposeChild(), snapshot(), dispose(). Injected notify(value) returns a deferred payload {value,events}; write(value) observes a state write, returned(payload) observes each operation completion. Native callback return port corresponds to the original awaited run result. Shell policy is independent from modal state; close is terminal for a modal instance.

checkpoints: A result delivered while the modal remains open updates value, emits write, then emits returned.
Closing the modal before a pending result completes prevents that result from changing value or emitting write; returned still receives the payload.
Calling run after close must not permit a later result to update modal state.
dispose closes the modal; disposeChild retains its existing behavior.
forbidden_effects: Changing modal state or emitting a modal write for a result received after close.
Migrating or otherwise changing the application-shell subscription.
Suppressing operation completion merely because the modal has closed.
lifecycle_identity: closed belongs to each Controller instance and close is terminal for that modal instance.
The application shell has an independent lifetime and policy.

obligations.text: Gate modal result application on whether the modal is still open when the completion callback processes the result; admission-time state alone is insufficient.
Preserve open-modal behavior: assign the payload value and emit write before emitting returned with the original payload.
Preserve notification invocation and operation completion reporting when the modal is closed; prevent only the obsolete modal state update.
Limit the fix to the modal subscription and preserve the independent application-shell subscription.

ordering_barriers: Check current modal closure after obtaining the deferred result and before assigning self.value or emitting write.
Preserve the existing write-before-returned order when a result is applied.
Account for closure during deferred notification handling; checking only before notify registration does not protect a later completion.
preservation: Keep run, close, disposeChild, snapshot, and dispose interfaces and existing lifecycle behavior.
Keep returned observable even when a modal write is skipped.
Preserve the original payload passed to returned.
Preserve existing callback boundaries and timely open-modal writes without adding asynchronous deferral.
